# Regulatory Compliance and Internal Control Review

This document outlines key tasks related to risk and compliance:

*   Investigate the legal risks standard update.
*   Review the regulatory changes quarterly.
*   Optimize the regulatory changes quarterly.
*   Investigate the regulatory changes for strategy 2026.
*   Update the internal control for strategy 2026.
